name: Monozukuri
title_zh: 先写验收标准再动手的匠人式编码流程
tagline_zh: 受够了 AI 一口气吐三百行、跑不起来还改不动？它逼你先说清「怎样算做完」，再一行行落地，每步都能验证、能回退。
tagline_en: Tired of AI dumping 300 lines that won't run? It makes you define 'done' first, then builds in verifiable.
desc_en: An AI coding skill that applies Japanese-inspired craftsmanship to build simple, correct, verifiable, and maintainable software.
why_zh: 把日式匠人的「先定标准、再做、再验」拆成可执行步骤，拒绝一次性生成，每步都留可验证的产物。
why_en: Turns Japanese craft discipline into executable steps: define, build, verify. No one-shot dumps; every step leaves a checkable.
limit_zh: 它是流程约束，不是代码生成器：不替你写业务逻辑，也不做性能调优。只适合你愿意先花时间写验收标准的项目；想一句话出成品。
limit_en: It's a process constraint, not a code generator: no business logic, no perf tuning. Only for projects where you'll write acceptance criteria first.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Craftsmanship coding flow that writes acceptance criteria.
